title: Complete the Q2 covenant and borrowing-base workbook

output.target_path: Shared/Finance/Treasury/Bank - covenants/2026 Q2 working/Q2 covenant headroom - lender review working.xlsx

prompt:
Edit this workbook in place:
`Shared/Finance/Treasury/Bank - covenants/2026 Q2 working/Q2 covenant headroom - lender review working.xlsx`

Preserve the two existing sheets and all extracted terms/Q1 values. Complete `Q2 Headroom Working` with referenced formulas for posted, proposed-WIP pro forma, threshold, and headroom for Leverage, FCCR, and Tangible Net Worth. Add exactly one new sheet named `Borrowing Base` containing a formula-driven summary of invoice count, gross AR, pre-concentration eligibility, customer cap, post-concentration eligibility, advance rate, and borrowing base.

Use this auditable layout on `Borrowing Base`: labels in A2:A8 and values in B2:B8 for Invoice Count, Gross Open AR, Pre-Concentration Eligible AR, Customer Cap, Post-Concentration Eligible AR, Advance Rate, and Borrowing Base. Put a `Covenant Support` section in A11:B18 with labels and source values for Funded Debt, Posted EBITDA, Pro Forma EBITDA, Posted FCCR, Pro Forma FCCR, Posted Tangible Net Worth, and Pro Forma Tangible Net Worth. `Q2 Headroom Working` must link to those support cells and to the thresholds on `Executed Terms`; headroom must be calculated by formula. Borrowing-base cap and advance calculations must also be formulas.

Begin with the bank-package request in `Requests/`. Locate the executed amendment rather than the old summary, AR eligibility exhibit, current debt schedule, posted accounting populations, and the complete proposed-WIP evidence chain. Do not treat the extracted terms in the workbook as a substitute for checking the controlling agreement. Derive cash taxes, unfunded capex, interest, principal and signed tangible assets from the released accounting populations; do not insert unsupported covenant constants. Apply the ARM-2318-specific Columbia dispute and government-debtor treatment described by the eligibility exhibit. The proposed WIP remains unposted. Recalculate with LibreOffice or Excel and save to the same path. The workbook is graded.
